chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi 'Umayr from Hafs ibn Suqah from whom informed him, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who comes to his wife from behind (her rear), he said: 'It is one of the two types of intercourse, and in it is the ritual bath (ghusl).'

key_terms.يَأْتِي أَهْلَهُ: comes to his wife (engages in intercourse)

ai.seo_question: Does intercourse from behind require ghusl in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that sexual intercourse from behind is considered one of the two primary modes of marital union, thereby requiring the major ritual bath (*ghusl al-janabah*) just as vaginal intercourse from the front does. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly view that the location of ejaculation, rather than the specific physical position, determines the obligation of *ghusl*, ensuring comprehensive purity for worship.
